title: How a Camshaft Works
narration: This is a camshaft. It decides when your engine breathes.
As it spins, each lobe pushes a valve open against its spring.
Past the peak, the spring snaps it shut, and each cylinder takes its turn.
It turns at half crankshaft speed: one opening per valve, every four strokes.
description: How a camshaft opens and closes your engine's valves, shown on an accurate 3D model of an overhead camshaft with bucket tappets (shown in slow motion). #shorts #cars #engine #mechanic #howitworks
